newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid cautious trading.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower ahead of weekend as majority scrips suffered loss amid cautious trade by retail investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index lost 3.21 points or 0.28 percent at 1,141.84 on a turnover of 67.1 million taka. Losers led the gainers by 87 to 45.
Brokers said investors were unlikely to become active until the announcement of new budget, due on June 12.
Chittagong Cement lost 37.22 taka to 2,018.29 and Bengal Fine Ceramics shed 10.78 to 460.
